patch_description: Keep direct demand as the primary signal and add a modest reward for two-link paths that serve positive-demand origin-destination pairs. Discount paths through nodes with high combined incoming and outgoing demand, which are more likely to become transit bottlenecks and can concentrate traffic. These O(n^3) interactions connect links that form useful routes while remaining below the quadratic-term limit. Increasing the degree penalty makes valid degrees more influential in the QUBO before samples are repaired.
